profile.title: Your profile at a glance
profile.lead: Doctors and care providers see these details only for bookings they accept.
profile.editLead: Fill in each item to be ready to book a visit. You can answer Unknown where you are not sure.
profile.notReady: {done} of {total} complete. Finish these to book a visit:
profile.unverifiedBody: Everything in your health record is what you told us. It stays unverified until a doctor confirms it with you in person.
profile.sharingBody: When a doctor accepts your booking, they can see this record to prepare for the visit. Nobody else in SureCure Visit can read it for other purposes.
profile.age: {years, plural, one {(# year old)} other {(# years old)}}

load.gatedTitle: Saved details are not available yet

form.noDocumentOfKind: Add a {kind} in the Verification documents step first, then choose it here.

hours.hint: Add one row for each day and time window. Times are in India Standard Time.

location.consent: We only ask your browser for your location when you press the button below, and we save it only when you save your profile.
location.mapUnavailable: Adjusting the pin on a map is not available yet.

common.displayNameHint: Use your professional or registered business name.
common.descriptionHint: What patients should know about your service. Do not include phone numbers.
common.languagesHint: Use language codes separated by commas, for example en, te, hi.
common.pinsHint: Six-digit PIN codes separated by commas. Our team checks coverage before you are listed.
common.weeklyHoursHint: Add each day and time window you are available.
common.photoUnavailable: Photo upload is not available yet. You can add a photo later.
common.rupeesHint: Amount in rupees, for example 800 or 800.50.
common.privateHint: Private: used for verification only, never shown to patients.
common.documentRefHint: Choose a document you added in the Verification documents step.

patient.birthHint: You must be 18 or older to create your own profile.
patient.locationHint: Helps the visiting provider find you. Shown only to providers of bookings you make.
patient.emergencyContactHint: Someone we can call if you cannot be reached during a visit.
patient.emergencyRelation: How they are related to you
patient.accessRouteHint: Adding someone does not give you access to their records. Adults are invited and must agree.
patient.consent: I agree that SureCure Visit may store these details and share them with providers of bookings I make
patient.consentHint: The privacy notice is a draft until the company publishes the approved version.

doctor.registrationNumberHint: As shown on your registration certificate.
doctor.issuingAuthorityHint: For example, the state medical council that registered you.
doctor.startingPointHint: Private: used to plan travel, never shown to patients.

lab.accreditationHint: Shown to patients only after our team checks it.
lab.staffHint: Staff join through an invitation. List the roles you plan to fill.

ambulance.serviceModeHint: Scheduled patient transport only. Emergency dispatch is not offered through SureCure Visit; in an emergency call 112.
ambulance.requestedClassHint: The class you apply for. Our team confirms it from the permit and equipment.

caretaker.agencyNameHint: Required if you work through an agency.
caretaker.trainingHint: List any caregiving training. Leave empty if you have none.
caretaker.tasksHint: Nursing tasks need a nursing registration that our team checks.
caretaker.nursingCredentialHint: Needed only if you choose a nursing task.
caretaker.ratesHint: Add one rate per period. Long-term plans are not available yet.

wizard.draftNote: Each step is saved to your account when you press save. Nothing is kept in this browser.
wizard.accountLead: Your sign-in details belong to your account. Check them, then continue.

patientWizard.title: Health questionnaire
patientWizard.lead: Answer each section as best you can. "Unknown" and "None" are real answers, so pick them when they are true.
patientWizard.reviewLead: Check what is still needed, give consent, then submit.
patientWizard.submitHint: You can submit once every required step is complete and your consent is saved.
patientWizard.incomplete: Some sections are still missing. Complete them, then submit again.
patientWizard.submitUnavailable: Submitting is not available yet. Your saved answers stay on your account.

providerWizard.lead: Complete the required steps and submit them for verification. Patients cannot book you until an admin has verified your details.
providerWizard.startLead: Enter the name patients will see. You can change it until you submit.
providerWizard.lockedBody: You cannot edit your application while its status is "{status}". Contact support if something needs to change.
providerWizard.changesBody: A verifier asked for changes. Update the steps listed below, then submit again.
providerWizard.documentsLead: Required document: {kind}. Documents are private. Only verification staff can see them.
providerWizard.uploadUnavailable: Document upload is not available yet. You can finish the other steps now and add documents when upload opens.
providerWizard.submitHint: You can submit once every required step is complete.
providerWizard.incomplete: Some required steps are still missing. Complete them, then submit again.
providerWizard.submitUnavailable: Submitting is not available yet. Your saved steps stay on your account.
